note: Shared by the Go reference test and the node run of protocol.js. dir=in: parseFrameMessage(msg) must equal expect (or null when valid=false). dir=out: validToBridge(msg) must equal valid. JSON cannot carry NaN/Infinity, so the non-finite number rules are covered by the Go and node tests directly. Large values are written as {"$str":[char,n]} and {"$repeat":[element,n]}; both runners expand them before use.
